name: Do I need to replace my window casing when I get new windows?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to replace my window casing when I get new windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often, yes, it's advisable to replace window casing when installing new windows. New window installations may alter the existing openings, making the old casing unsuitable. Additionally, replacing casing allows for a fresh, updated look that complements the new windows and ensures a complete seal against the elements. This is a practical tradeoff: investing in new casing alongside new windows ensures aesthetic consistency and optimal performance from your energy-efficient windows, preventing future issues with drafts or an unfinished appearance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, it's often advisable to replace casing with new windows. This ensures a fresh look, proper fit, and a complete seal, complementing the new installation.
